article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New? (German post: Die Free Realms Geburtstagsfeier!)
article_summaries.summary: A German-language official news post announcing Free Realms' second-anniversary birthday party (anniversary on April 28), running from the post date until May 18. It describes party locations, birthday quests, party items, a boss called Kuchenstein with his cakelings, and an eight-cake collection reward. The post gives no exact post date; the capture is dated 2011-04-30 and the page says 'Posted 1 week, 1 day ago'.

article_summaries.title: Die Free Realms Geburtstagsfeier! (Free Realms - What is New?)
article_summaries.summary: A German-language official SOE news post announcing Free Realms' first-anniversary birthday party, running from the launch-day kickoff until May 10, 2010, with party zones, new quests, party items, cakes and a boss fight against Cakenstein. The page is in German; the date is inferred from the capture (posted 6 days 13 hours before 2010-04-28), not printed in the text.
